# Positioned text groups

`positioned-runs.pdf` contains two headings followed by `abc`, `def`, `ghi`,
`jkl`, `mno`, `pqr`, `stu`, `vwx`, `yz`. Every group has an independent
`BT / Tm / Tj / ET` sequence (11 of each including the headings).

Generated with pdf-lib on a 600 × 800 page: headings at (40, 760) and (40, 730),
12pt; group i at (40 + 42 × i, 700), also 12pt. The headings are `Heading one`
and `Heading two`. The groups follow source order, unlike the reverse-order
fixture generated by the browser regression script.

PDF extraction emits a source space between these positioned groups. Text
layout omits the whitespace-only source items and inserts its own display
spacing. Therefore `mno pqr stu v` has canonical page-1 offsets [38, 51),
not the offsets of the unspaced alphabet. A short selection crosses four
independent positioning operations and must remain one saved range.

Run `POSITIONED=1 WEBBASE_BROWSER_URL='http://127.0.0.1:6229/?demo=1' node
scripts/check-webbase-pdf-draft.mjs` from the reader checkout. The script imports
this exact PDF through WebBase's real document and persistence path.

`two-page-positioned-runs.pdf` is a real two-page PDF (400 × 500 points),
generated with pdf-lib. Page 1 has `First page` at (30,450) and four independent
14pt groups `abc`, `def`, `ghi`, `jkl` at (30 + 45i,60). Page 2 has `Second page`
at (30,450) and `mno`, `pqr`, `stu`, `vwx` at (30 + 45i,400). Each heading and
word uses its own BT/Tm/Tj/ET sequence, ten positioning groups in total.

Request the explicit creation check with:

```sh
PDF_CROSS_PAGE_CREATE=1 WEBBASE_BROWSER_URL='http://127.0.0.1:6229/?demo=1' node scripts/check-pdf-text-cross-page.mjs
```

This prints an explicit **SKIP** with a reference to
`openspec/specs/pdfjs-web-reader/spec.md:67` and records `status: "skipped"` in
the JSON report. The spec forbids selection overflow from turning pages;
PDF Text mounts one original page at a time and Next discards the draft.
Cross-page continuation is a separate product requirement, outside this fix.
Both this command and default execution run the four saved cross-page edit
cases and exit successfully when those cases pass. A skip is not a creation pass.

The PDF and `checkCreation` implementation remain available for that future
requirement: import through WebBase from zero annotations, drag and release,
adjust handles, continue to page 2, confirm, switch Layout, deselect/reselect,
and assert one spanning annotation. Enable `creationSupport.enabled` only
after the product introduces that continuation interaction.
